David J. Winter

About the author

David J Winter began writing seriously as a securities analyst and in the writing of investment strategy pieces. He holds a B.S. in Finance from the University of Illinois, an MBA from Loyola University in Chicago and holds the Chartered Finalcial Analyst designation. He has taught Bible and Christian history at Valley Presbyterian Church and that, along with a lifelong interest in history, led Dave to delve into important periods in the history of Western Civilization that marked momentous turning points. He resides in Scottsdale, Arizona with his wife, Mary Ann. A son, daughter-in-law and three grandchildren live in Arlington Heights, Illinois

When Lee. M. Winter isn't writing books for kids, she works at her day job as a psychologist in the area of parenting and child behavior research. Lee has a number of extremely dry, boring - let's face it - brain numbing scientific publications out under a pen name.
